claim_boundary: These are product admission thresholds. They do not claim current Knight or Mage compliance and may only be tightened after result inspection, never relaxed to convert a failure into PASS.

metric_domain.interior_uncovered_fraction: uncovered source-component foreground outside the one-reference-pixel alpha boundary band / interior_source_component_foreground_area

g3.note: Subject-free numerical floor. Dynamic envelope stress proof remains independently required.
g3.dynamic_note: Stage-27 numerical conditioning bounds only. They reject severe LBS collapse/explosion/ill-conditioning under the frozen envelope; professional motion quality remains a later proof.

rationale: Thresholds are frozen before inspecting a Knight QualifiedMesh result.
Historical FIT2 aggregate coverage thresholds are not reused as outcome-fitted percentiles; the new unit is view x admitted component with explicit anti-peppering evidence.
PLANAR carriers receive stricter visible coverage because their product geometry is intentionally source-facing rather than volumetric.
CLIP is excluded from product-geometry carrier qualification and remains a QualifiedPresentationGraph mask semantic.
